question: Compare the performance of two brands or products and explain why they differ.
sql:
WITH items AS (
  SELECT p.brand, oi.sale_price, p.cost, oi.status,
         oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AS sold
  FROM order_items AS oi
  JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
)
SELECT brand,
       COUNTIF(sold) AS items_sold,
       ROUND(SUM(IF(sold, sale_price, 0)), 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(sold, sale_price, 0)), COUNTIF(sold)), 2) AS avg_price,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(sold, sale_price - cost, 0)), SUM(IF(sold, sale_price, 0))), 3) AS margin,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(status = 'Returned'), COUNTIF(status <> 'Cancelled')), 3) AS return_rate
FROM items
GROUP BY brand
ORDER BY revenue DESC
report: Compare on four measures: volume, average price, margin and return rate. Revenue, volume and margin count only items that were not cancelled or returned, as everywhere else; the return rate is returned items over all items that were not cancelled. A brand can lead on revenue and still be the weaker business if its margin is thin or its return rate is high. After finding the measure that differs most, look at category mix to explain it.
